## triage_issue_snapshot
Given an issue number, retrieve the issue’s record, official labels, and public comments for triage.

```text
issue_get_record({"issue_number": {issue-number}})
issue_get_labels({"issue_number": {issue-number}})
issue_get_comments({"issue_number": {issue-number}, "limit": {comment-limit}})
```
